description: The classic 5×5 Lights Out — every board is generated from solvable reverse moves. Turn all the lights off!

faqs.a: Pressing a light toggles it plus its four neighbors. The goal is all lights off.
Every board is made by applying random presses to the solved state, so a solution always exists.
The counter tracks your presses — fewer moves means a better score.
faqs.q: How is the move counter used?

faqs.a: Yes — press New Game for a fresh solvable board.
faqs.q: Can I get a new puzzle?

howto: Press New Game for a fresh board.
Tap lights — each toggles its neighbors too.
Turn every light off to win.
Use as few moves as possible!
title: Lights Out Game
